title: 1736 Prairie Avenue, built from its 1890 photograph
items: The house at the corner of 18th Street now looks like its c. 1890 photograph: pale painted walls, a slate mansard with two arched dormers, three hooded windows upstairs and a veranda across the whole front, its stair at the north end.
It is the sheet's full plan now, 23 m deep and 6.75 m wide, where the draft had only a narrow strip.
